spans.s: अचक्षुस् [acakṣus], a. Eyeless, blind; ˚विषय a.. invisible; अचक्षुर्विषयं दुर्गं न प्रमाद्येत कर्हिचित् ।
अचण्ड [acaṇḍa], a. Not hot-tempered, mild, gentle. अचण्डगतिं पवनम् Ki 6.25. -ण्डी A mild or tractable cow.
(Astr.) Epithet of the zodiacal signs वृषभ, सिंह, वृश्चिक and कुम्भ,
अचरम [acarama], a. Not last, middle &c.; वयस्यचरमे
अचल [acala], a. Steady, immovable, motionless, fixed, permanent; चित्रन्यस्तमिवाचलं चामरम्

N. of Śiva, of the soul, of the first of the 9 deified persons among Jainas. -ला The earth (so called because the earth is immovable according to one view, or, according to Ārya Bhaṭṭa who rejects this view, अचलाः पर्वताः सन्त्यत्र, अस्त्यर्थे अच्; अचलत्वात् स्वकक्षातो बहिर्गमनाभावाद्वा). cf. अचलः पर्वते वृक्षे कीलावसुधयोः स्त्रियाम् Nm. -लम् Brahman. -Comp -कन्यका, - सुता, -दुहिता, -तनया &c. N. of Pārvat&imcr;, daughter of the Himālaya mountain. -कीला (ब.) the earth (immovably fixed or pinned. -ज, -जात a. mountain-born. (-जा-जाता) N. of Pārvatī. -त्विष् a. [अचला त्विट् यस्य] of fixed or permanent lustre or colour. (-m, ˚ट्) a cuckoo (बहुप्रक्षालनेनापि मालिन्यानपगमात् स्थिरा त्विट्). (f.) permanent colour. -द्विष् m. [अचलान् द्वेष्टि, द्विष् -क्विप्] the enemy of mountains, epithet of Indra who clipped off their wings. -धृतिः f. a metre of four lines of 16 short 1syllables each (गीत्यार्या) -पतिः, -राट् lord of mountains, N. of Himālaya or Meru; समुद्र इव दुर्बोधः सत्त्वेनाचल- राडिव Bhāg 4.22.58. so ˚अधिपः, ˚श्रेष्ठः. -सप्तमी N. of a book in the भविष्योत्तरपुराण; the 7th day of the bright half of Āśvina.
अचापल [acāpala] ल्य [lya], ल्य a. [बहु.] Devoid of fickleness, steady. -लम्-ल्यम् [न. त.] Steadiness.
To speak, announce, declare, teach, tell, relate, communicate, say, narrate (usually with dat. of person); गुरवे... प्रस्तुतमाचचक्षे
To divine, bespeak; यथा मे हृदय- माचष्टे
To make known, acquaint, introduce to.
To look at, inspect (Ved.). आ चष्ट आसां पाथो नदीनाम्
आचतुरम् [ācaturam], ind. [चतुः पर्यन्तं अच् समासान्त] Till the fourth generation; आचतुरं हीमे पशवो द्वन्द्वं मिथुनायन्ते
आचन्द्रतारकम् [ācandratārakam], ind. As long as there are the moon and stars.
आचपराच [ācaparāca], a. Moving towards and away from. Tāṇḍya Br.
The water or foam of boiled riec (Mar. पेज);
आचमनम् [ācamanam], 1 Rinsing the mouth, sipping water before religious ceremonies, before and after meals &c. from the palm of the hand; दद्यादाचमनं ततः
(part of the water sipped being usually allowed to drop down).
The water used for rinsing the mouth.
N. of a plant Andropogon muricatum (Mar. वाळा).
Water for rinsing the vulva (Āyurveda). -Comp. -धारिन्, -वाहिन् m. A drawer of water; (
आचमनीय [ācamanīya], pot. p. Used for rinsing the mouth. -यम्, -आचमनीयकम् Water used for rinsing the mouth; a gargle.
To sip, lick, lap, drink (a small quantity); नाचेमे हिममपि वारि वारणेन
To rinse the mouth (with instr. of the thing);
To lick up, dry or drink up, absorb; आचामति स्वेदलवान् मुखे ते
. -Caus. To cause to sip water; पृष्ट्वा स्वदितमित्येवं तृप्तानाचामयेत्ततः
आचयक [ācayaka], a. Skilful in collecting or gathering (आचये कुशलः).
आचरणम् [ācaraṇam], 1 Practising, doing, performing, following, observing; धर्म˚, मंगल˚ &c.
An institute; rite or rule of conduct.
Approaching, arrival (as of the dawn); ये अस्या आचरणेषु दध्रिरे
आचरणीय [ācaraṇīya] आचरितव्य [ācaritavya] आचर्य [ācarya], आचरितव्य आचर्य pot. p. To be done, performed, followed, observed &c.; fit, right.
आचरण्यति [ācaraṇyati], Den. P. To move oneself, to move or extend towards; वां जिह्वा घृतमा चरण्यात्
Done, observed, practised, as a rite or usage &c.
One of the five means of recovering or paying back debt; धर्मेण व्यवहारेण छलेनाचरितेन च । प्रयुक्तं साधयेदर्थं पञ्चमेन बलेन च ॥
; see also Bṛihaspati quoted by Kull.
To act, practise, do, perform, undertake, exercise; असक्तो ह्याचरन् कर्म
; न चाप्याचरितः पूर्वैरयं धर्मः Mb.; so सेवाम्, विधिम्, स्नानम्, वृत्तिम्.
To act or behave towards (with loc.); तस्यां त्वं साधु नाचरः
To act, proceed, manage (without loc.); यद्यदाचरति श्रेष्ठः
To observe the usual formality; Ś.7.
To come near; approach (Ved.); आ वां चरन्तु वृष्टयः
To step upon, pass through, wander over or about; frequent, resort to, follow; तस्कराचरितो मार्गः Rām.; श्वापदाचरिते वने Mb.; अगस्त्याचरितामाशाम्
; परेताचरितां दिशम् Rām.; अविद्वज्जनाचरित एष मार्गः
To help forward, put into; हस्तेनाचरति Kāty. (हस्तेन प्रेरयति प्रक्षिपति).
(Actively used) One who has rinsed his mouth or sipped water.
Fit for sipping. -तीः f. Sipping (water) for purifying the mouth; B. R.
आचाम्य [ācāmya], pot. p. To be rinsed. -म्यम् Water used for rinsing.
Conduct, behaviour, manner of action or of conducting oneself; सदाचारः good conduct; नीच˚ &c.; लोकाचारविवर्जिताः
ignorant of the ways of the world.
Good conduct or behaviour; न शौचं नापि चाचारो न सत्यं तेषु विद्यते
A custom, usage, practice; तस्मिन्देशे य आचारः पारंपर्यक्रमागतः
An established usage, fixed rule of conduct in life, customary law, institute or precept (opp. व्यवहार in law); आचार्य आचाराणाम्
; oft. as the first member of comp. in the sense of 'customary', 'usual', 'as is the custom', 'according to form', 'as a formality'; ˚पुष्पग्रहणार्थम्
. (b) A form, formality; आचार इत्यवहितेन मया गृहीता Ś.5.3;
. (c) The customary salutation or bow, usual formality; आचारं प्रतिपद्यस्व Ś.4;

A rule (of conduct). -Comp. -अङ्गम् title of the first of the twelve sacred books of the Jainas-चक्रिन् N. of a Vaiṣṇava sect. -चन्द्रिका N. of a work on the religious customs of the Śūdras -तन्त्रम् one of the four classes of the Tantras (with Buddhists).-दीपः [आचारार्थः नीराजनार्थो दीपः]
'a lamp of religious customs', title of a work.
a lamp waved about a person as a formality and token of auspiciousness.-धूमग्रहणम् inhaling smoke as a customary rite (as of the sacrificial ceremony)
. -पूत a. purified by customary observances, of pure conduct; तमातपक्लान्त- मनातपत्रमाचारपूतं पवनः सिषेवे

. -भेदः difference in the customary law. -भ्रष्ट, -पतित a. apostate, fallen from established usages or rules of conduct. -मयूखः 'Ray of religious customs'; N. of a work. -लाज (m. pl.) fried grain customarily showered upon a king or other important personage as a mark of respect (as when he passes through the streets of his capital); अवाकिरन्बाललताः प्रसूनैराचारलाजैरिव पौरकन्याः
outcast, who has renounced all customary observances. स्मृत्याचारव्यपेतेन
. -वेदी [आचारस्य वेदीव] 'altar of religious customs', N. of Āryāvarta, the sacred region of the Āryas.
आचारवत् [ācāravat], a. Well-conducted, virtuous; भवत्याचार- वान्नित्यं यथेष्टा प्राप्नुयाद्गतिम्
आचारिक [ācārika], a. [आचार-ठक्] Conformable to rule or practice, authorized, prescriptive. -कम् Rule for the preservation of health; hygiene, regimen, diet.
आचारिन् [ācārin], a. [आचार्-णिनि, आचार-इनि वा] Following established customs.
आचारी [ācārī], N. of a plant (हिलमोचिका; Mar. चाकवत).

A spiritual guide or preceptor, holy teacher (one who invests a boy with the sacred thread, instructs him in the Vedas &c.); उपनीय तु यः शिष्यम् वेदमध्यापयेद् द्विजः । सकल्पं सरहस्यं च तमाचार्यं प्रचक्षते
; cf. also आचिनोति च शास्त्रार्थं आचारे स्थापयत्यपि । स्वयमाचरते यस्तु स आचार्य
read also वेदाध्यापनेन च आचार्यो भवति
One who propounds a particular doctrine.
(When affixed to proper names) Learned, venerable (somewhat like the English Dr.).
An adviser or preceptor at a sacrifice &c.
An epithet of Droṇa; आचार्यमुपसंगम्य राजा वचनमब्रवीत्
A degree or title of proficiency. -र्या A female preceptor, a spiritual preceptress. -Comp. -उपासनम् waiting upon or serving the spiritual preceptor; आचार्योपासनं शौचम्

.-देवः one whose preceptor is his god. -देशीय a. Somewhat inferior to Āchārya (a title applied by commentators to scholars or disputants whose statements contain only a part of the truth. The term is opposed to 'Āchārya' and 'Siddhāntin' Kaiyata and Nāgojibhatta on Pat.) -भोगीन a. [आचार्यभोगाय हितम् ख] to be enjoyed by, fit for the use of, a preceptor; delighting the preceptor. -मिश्र a. venerable, honourable. -सवः N. of an Ekāha sacrifice.
आचार्यक [ācāryaka], a. Originating from a spiritual preceptor;
कम् Instruction, tuition, teaching (lessons &c.); लङ्कास्त्रीणां पुनश्चक्रे विलापाचार्यकं शरैः
The proficiency of a spiritual teacher.
A post of a preceptor आचार्यकं कौरवाणां वाञ्छंस्तस्थौ कृपालये
Honouring the preceptor. चकाराचार्यकं तत्र कुन्तीपुत्रो धनञ्जयः
आचार्यता [ācāryatā] त्वम् [tvam], त्वम् The office or proficiency of a holy teacher; वाचामाचार्यतायाः पदमनुभवितुं कोस्ति धन्यो मदन्यः
Vārt.] The wife of an आचार्य or holy preceptor; शत्रुमूलमनुत्खाय न पुनर्द्रष्टुमुत्सहे । त्र्यम्बकं देवमाचार्यमाचार्यानीं च पार्वतीम्
